sourceSupport.evidence: Independent replay of the math: card return 0.03B + 0.01(T-B) - fee equals flat 0.02T when B = 0.5T + fee/0.02 = 0.5T + 1,950. At T = $30,000 that is B = $16,950 (56.5 percent, rounds to about 57); at $24,000 it is 58.1 and at $36,000 it is 55.4; with fee 0 it is exactly 50. Brute check at B = 16,950 gives $600 for both cards. Chase Unlimited 3% foreign fee remains verified against Chase's own page from round 1.
